base_setup_commands: apt-get install -y git curl xvfb npm chromium

runtime_profile.notes: Node.js 18.x environment with npm package manager. Chrome browser required for Karma-based browser tests. xvfb required for headless Chrome execution in CI.

notes: PlayCanvas WebGL game engine. Base image node:18-bookworm provides Node.js 18.x as per CI configuration. git, curl, npm, xvfb are installed via apt. Chrome and xvfb are required for karma browser tests. The project uses ESM modules (type: module in package.json). Test commands: 'npm test' for Node/Mocha tests, 'xvfb-run --auto-servernum npm run test:karma' for browser tests.
